source_text: Qui de ecclesia sumus Moysen recipimus ut prophetam figuris futura scribentem. Iudaeus litterae prophetam negat.
pass_a_gloss: Who from church we-are Moses we-receive as prophet with-figures future writing. Jew of-letter prophet denies.
pass_b_english: We of the church receive Moses as prophet writing futures in figures. The letter-only reader denies the prophet.
